title: Task 7: Dispatch character creation by rules system and preserve D&D
description:
Objective:
Introduce a system-aware character creation seam while keeping current D&D SRD behavior passing.

Files:
- Modify: `packages/core/src/characterCreation.ts` or split into `packages/core/src/characterCreation/*`
- Modify: `packages/cli/src/play.ts`
- Modify: `packages/core/src/index.ts`
- Test: `packages/core/test/characterCreation.test.ts`
- Test: `packages/cli/test/play.test.ts`

Steps:
1. Write failing tests that D&D character creation uses the campaign rules binding when no catalog argument is supplied and still accepts the existing legal fighter draft.
2. Write a failing CLI test that play on a D&D campaign still blocks turns until canonical character creation or `/defer`.
3. Run `npx vitest run packages/core/test/characterCreation.test.ts packages/cli/test/play.test.ts`; expected: FAIL after test changes until dispatch is implemented.
4. Define `CharacterCreationRulesContext` or equivalent with resolved binding/stack.
5. Move existing SRD-specific validation behind a D&D validator function without changing accepted output.
6. Update `completeCharacterCreation` to resolve the campaign binding from DB when available and dispatch by `base.systemId`.
7. Update CLI play only as needed to pass the DB-backed context; keep the existing prompts for D&D.
8. Run focused tests; expected: PASS.
9. Commit with `git add packages/core/src/characterCreation.ts packages/core/src/index.ts packages/cli/src/play.ts packages/core/test/characterCreation.test.ts packages/cli/test/play.test.ts` and `git commit -m feat-dispatch-character-creation-by-rules-system`.
acceptance_criteria: Existing D&D character creation and CLI play tests pass through the new dispatch seam. No public D&D behavior regresses.
close_reason: completeCharacterCreation now reads the campaign rules binding (default D&D SRD when none) and dispatches by base.systemId. D&D path is unchanged — existing SRD validators still drive validateCharacterDraft/buildCharacterCreationMutations behavior. Non-D&D systems (including Pathfinder, until Task 8) return a clear correction result naming the systemId and no canonical character writes occur. Verified: focused characterCreation + play vitest pass (24/24 RED→GREEN), full npm run typecheck and npm run test pass (375 passed, 2 documented skips).
